card.name: Linking words before a named condition
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as with, of and for in dosing headings, right before a patient group or disease is named (e.g. "patients with GCA", "treatment of Crohn's disease"). It also fires on a few odd spots inside a brand name or number.

modes.label: Patients with a condition
modes.description: The word "with" after a patient group in a dosage heading, before the disease.
modes.example: 2.2 Dosage in Pediatric Patients<< with>> Polyarticular Juvenile Idiopathic

modes.label: Treatment of a disease
modes.description: The word "of" or "for" after treatment or dosage, before the indication.
modes.example: For the treatment<< of>> ulcerative colitis or Crohn's

modes.label: Inside brand names or numbers
modes.description: Part of a brand name or a digit in a drug-label sentence.
modes.example: Withhold TAL<<VE>>Y until CRS resolves or permanently discontinue
